menu.label: Shape Tools
menu.supertip: Mighty Morpher, Custom Slides from Hidden, Spaced Out, Toggle Gradient, Bulk Rename and more.

button.label: Entry Manager
button.supertip: Add and manage calendar entries across months and years, organize them into named color groups, and show a per-month legend.

button.label: Make DateBar
button.supertip: Create a year/month/day date-bar timeline (the banded bar style).

button.label: Make Timeline
button.supertip: Read a timeline spreadsheet (Date / Time / Description) and draw a year-banded chronological timeline. Autofits to one slide or splits across slides.

menu.label: Formats
menu.supertip: Swap Time Format, Swap Month Format and Day Suffix Toggle.

button.label: Auto Center
button.supertip: Align every entry box on the slide: 1-2 lines centered, 3 or more lines left-aligned.

menu.label: Timeline Edits
menu.supertip: Tear Gap (tear a shape's edge) and Toggle Weighted Timeline (size columns by event count).

button.label: Copilot Prompt
button.supertip: Copy a ready-made Microsoft Copilot prompt that converts any timeline (PDF / Word / Excel) into the Date / Time / Description / Bates format Make Timeline needs.

button.label: Date Snap (Group Move)
button.supertip: Move each entry horizontally (the whole group) so its leader line lines up with its date on the datebar. Re-reads the current bar and entries.

button.label: Date Snap (Line Nudge)
button.supertip: Adjust only the leader line within each entry's box bounds to reach its date; lists any that can't fully reach and offers to group-move those.

button.label: Place Entry at Top
button.supertip: Move the selected entries so their date box tops sit at 1.15in from the slide top, then snap their leader lines to the datebar.

button.label: Space Evenly with Leaders
button.supertip: Distribute the selected entries with equal gaps based on their boxes only (ignoring the leader lines), moving each entry and its leader together.

button.label: Tear Gap
button.supertip: Select one shape, then tear its left or right edge (boolean-subtracts the tear, scaled to the shape's height).

button.label: Toggle Weighted Timeline
button.supertip: Re-flow the current imported timeline: size columns by how many events each unit has, or back to uniform width.

button.label: Z Axis Fix
button.supertip: Restack the entries on this slide so every leader line sits behind the entry boxes (groups preserved). Re-reads the current entries.

button.label: Check for Updates
button.supertip: Check GitHub for a newer version of the Trial Quest add-in and its template assets, then install it.

button.label: About
button.supertip: Show the installed add-in version and update settings.
